title: An in-flight change that declares a shared input covers an accepted change for now, and its archive records which one
description: an in-flight change that declares a shared input covers an accepted change for now, and its archive records which one
acceptance_criteria: An accepted change whose signed input a later approved, implementing or verifying change has edited, and whose module and path that change declares, reads `provisionally-covered` naming it; `change audit` and `change audit --strict` exit 0 with a warning naming both changes; with no such change it is stale and audit fails as before.

`change archive`, or `change finalize` on workflow v2, accepts a provisionally covered change and writes `coverage.json` naming each covered input and its covering change; a provisionally covered change neither covers another change nor replaces one in a retirement, and `change reopen` still accepts it.

An archived change that was covered for now reads `authenticated-history` whatever becomes of the covering change; when that change is sent back or closed, `change status`, `change show` and `change audit --archives` warn that the input has no accepted change behind it and name `change reopen`.
Each of the two archive refusals over one stale delivery input names the other change and says it is blocked too, and the `change reopen` it names frees both.
Released SpecSync 6.3.0 reads an archive that holds `coverage.json` as before: archived, `authenticated-history`, audit and doctor clean.

answers.constraints: a provisionally covered change neither covers another change nor replaces one in a retirement; reopen stays allowed; archived integrity is unchanged and does not read coverage.json; released 6.3.0 reads an archive that holds coverage.json as before
